------------------------------- Resonance Parameter and Angular Distribution Information -------------------------------
29-Cu- 65 ORNL, MIT Resonance Evaluation Including Covariance and Angular Distribution of Elastic Scattering
V. Sobes, L. C. Leal, K. Guber, G. Arbanas and D. Wiarda B. Forget
Resolved resonance parameter evaluation for Cu-65 was done with the computer code SAMMY.[ref1] The following data were used in the SAMMY analysis.
Reference | Energy (eV) | Facility | Measurement --------------------|-------------------|----------|------------ Pandey et al.[ref2] | 32 - 185 000 | ORELA | Trans. 78m Pandey et al.[ref2] | 1 000 - 1 400 000 | ORELA | Trans. 78m Guber et al.[ref3] | 100 - 90 000 | GELINA | Capt. 58m Guber et al.[ref3] | 100 - 300 000 | GELINA | Capt. 58m Sobes et al.[ref4] | 0.01 - 0.1 | MITR | Trans. 1.2m
The MITR transmission measurements were important for determining the shape and the uncertainty of the thermal cross section.
A set of resonance parameter describing the experimental data was obtained. Resonance parameter covariance matrices were also obtained in the SAMMY evaluation process. The upper energy boundary of the resonance region of Cu-65 was extended from 99.5 keV to 300 keV.
Thermal cross section obtained in the present evaluation are compared to the values listed in the Atlas of Neutron Resonances in the following table:
Cross Section ORNL Atlas Capt 2.149+/-0.06 2.17+/-0.03 Total 15.934+/-0.16 16.27+/-0.5 Scat 13.785+/-0.41 14.1+/-0.5
Capture Res. Int. 2.008+/-0.46 2.19+/-0.07 Energy Limits 0.5 eV - 300 keV 0.5 eV - 20.0 MeV
Angular distribution data for elastic scattering for incident neutron energies between 1e-5 eV and 300 keV were generated directely from the new resonance parameters in File 2 on a fine energy grid. The new elastic scattering angular distribution data gives a much more detailed treatment of the angular distribution than previous evaluations.
[ref 1] N. M. Larson,"Updated Users' Guide for SAMMY," Oak Ridge National Laboratory report ORNL/TM-9179/R6 (2003) [ref 2] M. S. Pandey, J. B. Garg, J. A. Harvey, "Neutron total total cross sections and resonance parameters of 29-Cu-65 and 29-Cu-65. I." Physical Review C, 15(2):600, (1997) [ref 3] K. Guber, S. Kopecky, P. Schillebeeckx, and P. Siegler, Private communication. Radiative capture measurements of highly enriched Cu-63 and Cu-65 and the GELINA Time-of-Flight experiment in Geel, Belgium (2011) [ref 4] V. Sobes, R. Macdonald, L. Leal, B. Forget, K. Guber, G. Kohse,"Thermal Total Cross Section Measurement for Cu-63 and Cu-65 at the MIT Reactor," Proceedings of ANS Winter Meeting (2011)
